headline: Strengthening Innovation, Bank Raya's Performance Grows Positively in Q3-2026
summary: PT Bank Raya Indonesia (AGRO) reported net profit of Rp21 billion in the third quarter of 2026. The result was driven by its digital business and growth in savings deposits.
why: Bank Raya is a small Indonesian digital-focused lender listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, so its quarterly results inform investors on the country's fintech and mid-tier banking segment.
original_headline: Perkuat Inovasi, Kinerja Bank Raya Tumbuh Positif di Kuartal III-2026
